note: Frozen before any A4 generation. Each item passes when (1) the response contains at least one keyword of must_contain_any (case- and accent-insensitive, whole response), (2) the response language matches lang by the stop-word rule of c50_a4_checks.py, and (3) generation ended on a stop ID within the token budget. Keywords are chosen to be unambiguous answers; spelling variants are listed.
